### Our Source of Security
Author: Shirley M. Dobson
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/daily-devotions-for-parents-by-dr-james-dobson/dr-dobsons-parenting-devotional-nov-12.html
Passage: 2 Thessalonians 3:3
Points:
- Unexpected crises and loss can test faith, but families should unite in prayer rather than despair.
- God proves His faithfulness by meeting real needs and protecting His people in times of vulnerability.
- Parents can help fearful or anxious children by teaching them to rest on God's reassuring promises.
- Genuine stability and protection for a family originate from God rather than earthly circumstances.

### Paul Asks for Prayer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/paul-asks-for-prayer
Passage: 2 Thessalonians 3:1-2
Points:
- Divine sovereignty does not negate human responsibility; confidence in God's plan actually fuels urgent prayer.
- Believers must actively pray that the gospel message advances rapidly and is received with honor.
- Paul requested deliverance from hostile people not for comfort, but to remove hindrances to the mission.
- Faithful Christians should continually intercede for the spiritual breakthrough and conversion of unbelievers.
